profileHints.utf8Eci26: UTF-8 / ECI 26 · Square modules · Quiet zones are preserved in the SVG.
profileHints.printableAscii: Input is preserved. Only printable ASCII is accepted.
profileHints.code49: ASCII 0–127, preserving case and control characters; row and symbol checksums are generated automatically. Stacks 2–8 rows; Unicode and ECI are not supported.
profileHints.gs1128Gtin: Enter a complete 14-digit GTIN, encoded as GS1-128 with AI (01). Check digit generation must be selected explicitly.
profileHints.gs1128Ai: Use GS1 AI bracket syntax, such as (01)09521234543213(10)LOT123. The engine validates AIs and their data.
profileHints.upca: Enter a complete 12-digit UPC-A; enter only 11 data digits when generating the check digit.
profileHints.upce: Enter number system 0/1, six compressed data digits and a check digit. Validation uses the expanded UPC-A.
profileHints.code11: Digits and hyphens; auto generates one or two check digits based on data length. Input excludes check digits.
profileHints.interleaved2of5: Digits only. The total length, including any checksum, must be even. Zeros are never added silently.
profileHints.code39: Digits, uppercase letters, spaces and -.$/+%; exclude start/stop *. Optional Mod 43 checksum.
profileHints.code39FullAscii: Full ASCII 0–127; disable HRI for control characters. Letter case is preserved.
profileHints.code93: Code 93 basic character set; required C/K checksums are generated automatically.
profileHints.printingMark: Digits-only printing and binding marks; verify orientation and host output manually.
profileHints.mod10Digits: Digits only; Mod 10 is generated by default. Other checksums can be selected explicitly. Input excludes checksums.
profileHints.pharmacodeSingle: One-track value 3–131070; preserves bar width ratios. HRI is off by default.
profileHints.pharmacodeTwoTrack: Two-track value 4–64570080; HRI is off by default.
profileHints.telepen: Telepen Alpha / ASCII 0–127; disable HRI for control characters.
profileHints.isbn13: Complete ISBN-13 (978/979; 9790 belongs to ISMN). Existing hyphens are allowed. Enter add-on data separately.
profileHints.ismn: Complete 13-digit ISMN (9790 prefix). Existing hyphens are allowed.
profileHints.issn: Complete ISSN (the last character may be X). The sequence variant forms the main code; enter EAN-2 add-on data separately.
profileHints.asciiOnlyNoEci: The engine currently accepts printable ASCII only. ECI is not supported; Chinese text is never silently encoded with the wrong character set.
profileHints.microQr: Micro QR / Printable ASCII / Automatic version and error correction; two-module quiet zone.
profileHints.codablockF: Codablock F / Printable ASCII / Automatic stacked layout with preserved row and column proportions.
profileHints.maxicode: MaxiCode modes 2/3 use separate postal code, country code and service class fields. Modes 4/5 encode general ASCII messages.
profileHints.mailmark: Mailmark 2D types 7/9/29; preserves the JGB header and spaces, with a 4X quiet zone. Technical generation; business and industry acceptance is pending.
profileHints.ntin: NTIN-DE / 04150 prefix / Embedded PZN checksum / GS1 Data Matrix; technical generation, industry acceptance pending.
profileHints.composite: Enter the linear number and 2D GS1 AI content separately. The linear number is validated; the engine validates 2D AIs.
profileHints.utf8Eci: UTF-8 / ECI 26; preserves original content and symbology quiet zones.
profileHints.ppn: PPN-DE / 11 prefix / PZN and ASCII-weighted Mod 97 checksums / ISO 15434 Format 06; technical generation, industry acceptance pending.
